probes.question: Hello, I'm Dr Okafor, one of the emergency doctors on tonight. Is it alright if I ask you a few quick questions?
probes.credits: Introduced yourself by name and role

probes.question: When did this pain first start, and did it come on all at once?
probes.target: You were well until 10 o'clock last night, when the pain came on suddenly.

probes.question: Can you show me where it hurts the most?
probes.target: The pain is in the middle of your upper stomach, just below the breastbone. Say "It is mostly right here" and that you point there, and that now it hurts all over.

probes.question: Does the pain spread anywhere else, like round to your back?
probes.target: It also goes through to the middle of your back, like a knife.

probes.question: What sort of pain is it? Can you put it into words for me?
probes.target: It is 10 out of 10. Stabbing.

probes.question: Is it there the whole time, or does it ease off and then come back?
probes.target: It never goes away. It is constant.

probes.question: Have you found anything that makes it a bit easier, or anything that makes it hurt more?
probes.target: Nothing makes it better. Keeping completely still helps a little. Any movement makes it much worse.
probes.credits: What makes it better or worse

probes.question: Have you been sick at all since it started?
probes.target: The pain did not let up. At midnight you vomited. Vomiting did not change the pain. It just kept going.

probes.question: What did the sick look like? Was there any blood in it, or dark bits like coffee?
probes.target: The vomit was last night's dinner, greenish yellow, not much of it. No blood and nothing like coffee grounds.

probes.question: Have you felt hot and cold, or had any shivering fits?
When did you last go for a poo?
probes.target: You have not opened your bowels since yesterday.

probes.question: Have you noticed your poo looking very dark or black lately?
probes.target: Your stools have looked black once or twice in the last few weeks. You thought it was something you ate.

probes.question: Have you ever had a pain anything like this in the past?
probes.target: You have never had pain like this before.

probes.question: Over the last few months, have you been getting a burning feeling in your stomach?
probes.target: You have had burning stomach pain on and off for months, and you take antacids most days.

probes.question: Do you take any tablets regularly, including anything for aches and pains?
probes.target: You take ibuprofen most days for your back, from the driving.

probes.question: Did you take anything for it last night before bed?
probes.target: You thought it was indigestion and took several antacids, then went to bed.

probes.question: Do you smoke, and how much alcohol do you usually have?
probes.target: You smoke a pack a day. You drink a few beers most evenings.

probes.question: Have you ever had an operation on your tummy?
probes.target: NOT IN CASE

probes.question: Any stinging when you pass water, or needing to go more often?
probes.target: NOT IN CASE

probes.question: Have you had any runny, watery poo?
probes.target: NOT IN CASE

probes.question: Have you noticed any lump or swelling in your groin?
probes.target: NOT IN CASE

probes.question: Is there anything else you think I should know?
probes.target: OPEN

probes.question: Is anything else bothering you right now?
probes.target: OPEN
